sentiment.rationale: Maersk raised its full-year 2025 underlying EBIT guidance from $0-3bn to $2-3.5bn and underlying EBITDA guidance from $6-9bn to $8-9.5bn, a material upward revision. The guidance raise is attributed to more resilient market demand outside North America and a strong first-half performance, not to one-time items or FX. Management language is confident, citing strong execution and operational improvements across all segments, though geopolitical uncertainty and the Red Sea disruption remain as noted risks.

summary.revenue: Q2 2025 consolidated revenue of USD 13,130m, up 2.8% year-on-year (USD 12,771m).
summary.eps: Q2 2025 earnings per share of USD 38 (Q2 2024: USD 51).
summary.guidance: Full-year 2025 underlying EBITDA raised to $8.0-9.5bn (previously $6.0-9.0bn), underlying EBIT raised to $2.0-3.5bn (previously $0.0-3.0bn), free cash flow raised to -$1.0bn or higher (previously -$3.0bn or higher). Global container market volume growth revised to 2%-4% (previously -1% to 4%).
summary.margin: Q2 2025 EBITDA margin 17.5% (Q2 2024: 16.8%), EBIT margin 6.4% (Q2 2024: 7.5%), underlying EBIT margin 6.2% (Q2 2024: 5.9%).
key_risks: Unprecedented geopolitical volatility and low visibility into macroeconomic factors.
Continued pressure on loaded freight rates due to supply-demand imbalance.
Red Sea disruption expected to last for the full year, adding network costs.
Uncertainty around US trade policy and tariffs.
Logistics & Services North America revenue down 8% year-on-year.
Ocean EBIT margin declined sequentially from 8.3% in Q1 2025 to 2.7% in Q2 2025.
key_opportunities: Gemini cooperation successfully phased in, achieving >90% schedule reliability and on track for cost savings.
Terminals delivered record-high volumes and ROIC of 15.4%, well above 9% target.
Logistics & Services EBIT margin improved to 4.8% (3.5% year-on-year), trending toward 6% target.
Strong volume growth in Ocean (4.2% year-on-year, 10% sequentially) and high utilization of 94%.
More resilient market demand outside North America supporting guidance raise.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management states 'strong performance in a volatile external environment' and 'we are well prepared to manage these ongoing challenges,' while raising guidance and highlighting successful execution of strategic initiatives like Gemini.
